description: Photographic exposure value: solve aperture, shutter, ISO or EV, with equivalent exposures — Given any three of aperture (f-number), shutter time in seconds, ISO and scene EV at ISO 100, solves the fourth from EV = log2(N^2/t) and EV_S = EV_100 + log2(S/100), names the nearest one-third-stop f-number, and lists the equivalent shutter time at each f-number from f/1 to f/32. Given all four, checks that they agree within a tolerance in stops. Built for camera, lighting and image-generation a

ev100.description: Scene light as exposure value at ISO 100.

toleranceStops.description: When all four are given: largest EV100 disagreement accepted (default 0.05).

name: exposure-calc
